verdict.rationale: NVIDIA docs confirm 96GB GDDR7 VRAM explicitly marketed for local LLM inference and fine-tuning (docs-1, docs-12), and community hands-on evidence shows multiple RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell cards running LLM inference workloads at real throughput (41k tok/s) (comm-1), corroborating practical large-model inference. However, published memory bandwidth figures are absent from the evidence, and community notes flag SM120 library-support gaps that can affect some inference stacks (comm-4). Missing for 10: explicit memory-bandwidth spec citation, single-GPU 70B-model benchmark data, and resolution of the SM120 library-support caveat.
